items.prompt: How handle a parser-supplied PUSH argument?

options.why: Text comparison is lexicographic, so for example 10 can sort before 2 as strings rather than after it numerically.
The sign is part of the integer value; discarding it can reverse which value is minimum.
The contract is integer-based; floating conversion is unnecessary and can lose exactness for large integers.
The supplied parser passes text, so int(op[1]) restores signed integer comparison and output semantics.

items.explanation: Numeric order differs from lexicographic order.
